mapper.insert: INSERT INTO okx_paper_account_heads(inst_id) VALUES(#{instId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inst_id=VALUES(inst_id)
mapper.select: SELECT session_id FROM okx_paper_account_heads WHERE inst_id=#{instId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE okx_paper_account_heads SET session_id=#{sessionId} WHERE inst_id=#{instId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM okx_paper_sessions s JOIN okx_paper_account_heads h ON s.session_id=h.session_id WHERE h.inst_id=#{instId}
SELECT FROM okx_paper_sessions s WHERE s.inst_id=#{instId} AND s.session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE okx_paper_sessions SET version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE okx_paper_sessions SET cash=#{cash},position_quantity=#{positionQuantity},position_cost=#{positionCost},realized_pnl=#{realizedPnl},total_fees_quote=#{totalFeesQuote},last_price=#{lastPrice},valuation_at=#{valuationAt},version=#{version},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE okx_paper_sessions SET status='ARCHIVED' WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM okx_paper_sessions WHERE inst_id=#{instId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE okx_paper_sessions SET risk_state_json=#{json} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM okx_paper_fills f WHERE f.decision_id=#{decisionId}
SELECT FROM okx_paper_equity e WHERE e.session_id=#{sessionId} AND e.kind='MARK' ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM okx_paper_sessions s WHERE s.inst_id=#{instId} AND s.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM okx_paper_fills f JOIN okx_paper_sessions s ON s.session_id=f.session_id WHERE s.inst_id=#{instId} AND f.session_id=#{sessionId} AND f.id < #{beforeId} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
